Roof Plumbing & Re-Roofing in Mount Martha

Sandhurst Roofing is a family owned roofing business with more than 30 years of experience looking after homes right across Mount Martha. From re-roofs in COLORBOND® steel and roof plumbing to guttering and tile to tin conversions, we back every job with honest advice and quality workmanship.

Mount Martha sits close to the water, so we know what salt air and wind do to metal roofs, flashings and gutters, and we recommend materials that stand up to it. Call Steve on 0448 812 800 for a free, no-obligation quote.

Get a Free Quote!

Roofs in Mount Martha: What We Commonly See

Mount Martha is known for large, established homes on generous blocks, many of them with roofs that are now well past their best. Newer coastal builds and re-roofs in COLORBOND® steel sit alongside them.

The town's bayside and clifftop position means strong winds and salt spray off Port Phillip Bay are a constant. That lifts and cracks ridge capping and corrodes metal fixings, valleys and gutters over time. The jobs we are called out for most in Mount Martha are refixing lifted ridge capping, re-roofing worn-out roofs, tracing leaks around flashings, and replacing rusted guttering on exposed homes.

Re-Roofing & Roof Replacement in Mount Martha

When a roof has reached the end of its life, replacing it is the smarter long-term spend. We re-roof Mount Martha homes in COLORBOND® steel, which is light, strong and well suited to bayside weather, and we use quality fixings, flashings and gutters that stand up to salt air.

If you are thinking about going metal, our tile to tin service is a popular way to lose the weight and the upkeep. If you are unsure whether you need a full re-roof, we will inspect the roof, show you what we find and give you an honest recommendation.

Roof Plumbing & Guttering in Mount Martha

Our registered roof plumbers look after the parts of the roof that take the most punishment near the water: flashings, valleys, ridge capping, box gutters and downpipes. Salt air eats through poorly finished metal quickly, so we trace leaks back to the real source and fix them properly rather than patching the ceiling stain.

We replace guttering, downpipes and fascia capping in COLORBOND® steel, from a single damaged section through to a complete gutter replacement, and we carry out gutter repairs where a repair is all that is needed. We remove the old guttering cleanly and leave the site tidy.

What Affects the Cost of Roofing in Mount Martha

There is no standard price for a roof, because no two roofs are the same. The size and pitch of the roof, the profile and colour of the steel, the amount of guttering, flashings and downpipes, and the access to the site all affect the quote. We inspect the roof, put the price in writing and explain every line.

Our Mount Martha Roofing Process

We start with a free on-site inspection and a written quote. For a re-roof we strip the old roof, prepare the framing, fit insulation and sarking where needed, then re-sheet in new COLORBOND® steel with fresh flashings, ridge capping, gutters and downpipes. We leave the site clean and tidy when we are done.

Why Mount Martha Locals Choose Sandhurst Roofing

We are fully licensed and insured, with registered roof plumbers on the team, so your job is done to standard and you are covered. As a local, family run business we treat your home the way we would treat our own, turn up when we say we will, and give honest advice rather than a hard sell. Mount Martha Roofing FAQs

Does living near the bay affect my roof?

Yes. Salt air corrodes metal roofs, fixings, flashings and gutters faster than it does inland, so coastal homes benefit from quality COLORBOND® materials and regular checks.

How long does a re-roof take?

Most homes are completed in a few days, weather depending. We will give you a realistic timeframe with your quote.

Do you offer free quotes?

Yes, every quote is free and without obligation. Call Steve on 0448 812 800.

Suburbs We Service Near Mount Martha

As well as Mount Martha we look after nearby homes in Mornington, Mount Eliza, Safety Beach, Dromana and Frankston.
